pages.text: The Gem Cutter accepts a suitable uncut gem, presents the cuts available for that material, and produces the selected cut in its result slot.$(br2)Different gem-and-cut combinations are experiments. A combination I have never completed before can produce Insight; simply repeating known work does not.

A second workstation now seems possible: a $(item)Jeweler's Table$() where a cut gem can be fitted into an empty ring or necklace.$(br2)I have not yet settled the bench's exact construction materials, but the purpose of each part is becoming clear.
